344134.「あら？\n どんな獰猛な竜が 待ち受けてるかと思えば。\n これなら すぐ 片:
What's this? I was expecting some ferocious
dragon we'd have to slay, but this'll be
quick and easy.

344136.「ほう…… 魔族を 食い飽きたところに\n ヒトの子が のこのこと やってくると:
Well, well... Just when I grew tired of
devouring demons, some children of man
appear upon my doorstep. How fortuitous!

344137.「そうそう！\n 竜退治っていったら こんくらいなきゃ\n テンション 上がらな:
Yeah, that's it! This is EXACTLY what I meant
when I said dragon slaying! It has to be just
like this to be worth getting excited for!

344138.「……でも さすがに この数を\n 一度に 相手するのは 効率悪いか。:
But I suppose trying to take all of you on
at once wouldn't be what I call efficient use
of our time...

344139.「火山では おいしいところを もらったし\n 今回は <cs_pchero>に:
I had my fun at the volcano, so this one's
yours, <cs_pchero>!
Anneliese and I will handle the small fry!

344140.「ヒトの子よ その命 食らってやろう……。\n 我が 葬魂のチカラの 糧となるが:
Your life shall be devoured...and your soul
shall sustain mine own power!

344143.「お疲れ様！\n やっぱり 強いわね <cs_pchero>！: Great job! You're real strong, you know that?

344144.「それが 葬魂の竜玉？\n なんだか すごく強い気を 感じるわ……。\n それで:
So that's the Burial Ball? It's giving off a
really powerful aura...yet there's something
quite pure about it, too...

344145.「邪神の復活のときのように\n ゼルゲイドは その竜玉を使って\n よからぬこと:
Zelgeid may be plotting to use it for
something even more sinister...

344146.「ま そうでしょうね。\n なんにせよ 竜玉を渡さなければ 問題ないわ。:
Could be. As long as we don't let it fall
into his hands, then I think we'll be fine.

344147.「それよりも これ……。\n ビクチャさんが 言っていた塩じゃないかしら。\n:
Oh, that's right...isn't this the salt Bikcha
was talking about? He said they gave up on
it because of all the monsters...

344148.「わあっ。\n 塩の結晶が キラキラ 光っているわ。\n 宝石のカケラみたい……:
Wow! The salt crystals are all sparkly!
They're just like little jewels...

344149.「塩は あたしたちが 生きるのに必要なもの。\n 宝石に負けないくらい 美しく\:
Can't live without salt in our daily lives.
It may as well be as valuable as a jewel
considering how important it is.

344150.「さあ 竜玉を 手に入れたことだし\n 要塞に戻りましょう。中央塔の兵士に\n:
Alright! Now that we've got the Ball, let's
head back. We've got some bragging to do
to get ourselves inside that tower.

344151.「……だ 誰？ この研究室に いきなり……。: W-who are you? What are you doing here?

344152.「なんだ キミか……。\n あれだけ言ったのに まだいるなんて。\n もしかして:
Oh, it's you... You're still here after
everything I said? Perhaps you're
just stupid, or something?

344153.「彼が 俺を 地下牢から\n 逃がしてくれたんだ。: He's the one who helped me escape.

344154.「あなたが 兄さんを？\n 魔皇軍の人が いったい どうして……。:
You're the one who helped my brother?
But you're part of the Dark Dominion...so
why would you...

344155.「別に……。\n 昔の知り合いに ちょっと似てたから\n 魔が差しただけだよ。:
It was nothing... He just so happens to look
like someone I used to know. It was just
a momentary lapse in judgment.

344156.「見たところ 技術者のようだけど……。\n ずいぶん 若いのね。\n 驚いちゃっ:
You certainly look like some kind of
technician...but you're so young!
Color me surprised.

344157.「魔皇軍の技術って 信じられないほど\n 高度だから 熟練のおじいちゃんみたいの:
The Dominion's military technology is insanely
advanced, so I guess I was picturing some
grizzled old man instead.

344158.「ずいぶん 短絡的な考えだね。\n こう見えても 僕は ここの技術主任。\n 魔:
Talk about a narrow-minded assumption...
Believe it or notーI'm chief engineer. Here
in the Dominion, age matters not...

344159.「魔皇軍にとって 役立つ能力があったから\n 今 僕はここにいる。\n 単純な事:
The reason I'm here is because I had skills
that they found useful. It's that simple.
Is that easy enough for you to understand?

344161.「……あら？\n これ 勇者さまの絵本ね。なつかしいわ。:
Oh... It's the Hero's picture book.
It sure brings back memories...

344162.「か…勝手に さわらないでっ！: D-don't touch that without asking first!

344163.「俺たちも 子供の頃 よく読んだよな。\n さまよえる亡霊たちを 光の玉で\n:
We sure read that a lot when we were little,
huh? Your favorite part was when the spirits
were purified with the Orb of Light.

344164.「あなたも かつて 存在したという\n 勇者さまに 憧れているの？\n 同じよう:
Do you also admire the Hero from ages past?
I'm happy to know there's others who feel the
same way I do!

344165.「俺を 助けてくれたことといい……\n 君は 人の心を 持ちあわせているように\:
And then there's the fact that you saved me...
You strike me as someone with a kind heart.
Why did you join the Dominion, then?

344166.「ヤツらが これまで\n どれほど 残虐な行為を くり返してきたか\n 知らない:
Surely you're aware of the countless
atrocities this army has committed over the
years.

344167.「知ってるよ。だから何？\n 僕には 他に 選択肢がなかったから\n こうしてい:
Yes, I know...and so what? I'm only doing
this because I had no other choice.

344168.「ほら いつまで ここにいるつもり？\n メネシス様が 本国から戻ってこないうち:
Just how long as you planning on staying here?
You really should leave before Lord Nemethys
returns here from his homeland.

344169.「なーんだ。メネシスは 今いないのね。\n 末端の兵士には 不在を隠してたってこ:
Uh huh...so he isn't here right now. Seems
they were keeping his absence a secret from
the grunts. How convenient for us!

344170.「まさか メネシス様を 倒そうとしてるの？\n 不可能だよ。誰も あの方には\n:
You're not seriously trying to defeat him, are
you? It's impossible. No one stands a chance
against him.

344171.「地下迷宮に 隠されている\n 魂の盃が あるかぎりね……。:
As long as the Chalice of Souls remains hidden
underground, it's pointless...

344172.「魂の盃……？\n もしかして それが\n あいつの不死に 関係しているの？:
Chalice of Souls? Could that be related to his
immortality, I wonder?

344173.「そうだよ。メネシス様は\n 魂の盃に 死者の魂を捕らえて\n 自らの再生のため:
That's right. Lord Nemethys captures souls
within the Chalice and uses them to
regenerate himself.

344174.「あの方を生かす資源として 数えきれないほどの\n 人々が いけにえに 捧げられ:
Countless lives were offered as sacrifices to
sustain him. Adults, children, friends,
foes... It didn't matter who.

344175.「……僕が 住んでいた町も 焼かれて。\n 父上も 母上も おばあさまも……\n:
The town I lived in was burned to the
ground... My father, my mother, my
grandmother...all sacrificed.

344176.「メネシスめ むごいことを……！: How unbelievably cruel... Damn you, Nemethys!

344177.「僕は メネシス様に命乞いし 忠誠を誓った。\n それから 僕は あの方の道具な:
I begged for my life and swore loyalty to him.
Since then, I've been nothing more than a tool
to him... Go on. Go ahead and laugh.

344178.「そんなこと 言わないで！\n あなたは 道具なんかじゃない……。:
Don't say things like that!
You're no tool...

344179.「それで？ あんたは あきらめたってワケ？\n あんたの好きな 勇者さまだったら:
Well? Does that mean you've just given up?
Would your beloved Hero hang his head
like that?

344181.「……ま あいつの企みが なんであれ\n これ以上 犠牲者を出さないためにも\n:
Well, whatever his schemes are...we know one
thing. We have to destroy that Chalice
to make sure there are no more victims.

344182.「そうすれば メネシスの脅威もなくなる。\n 君も ここから 抜け出せるんじゃな:
That way, Nemethys won't be a threat anymore.
You want to get out of this place too, don't
you?

344183.「……まあ やるだけ 無駄だろうけど\n そこまで言うなら がんばってみれば？:
Well...it's probably pointless to even try.
But, if you insist...what's the harm in
trying?

344184.「地下迷宮の入り口は 謁見の間にある。\n メネシス様が お戻りにならないうちに:
You can get underground through the audience
chamber. You'd best hurry and go before
Nemethys returns.

344185.「そうさせてもらうわ おくびょうな勇者くん。:
Then we'll go ahead and do just that, Mr.
Cowardly Hero.

344186.「下を向いて ふさぎこんでいても\n なんの意味もないわ。前を向いて\n 踏み出:
There's no point in hanging your head and feeling sorry for yourself. You have to look ahead and take that first step forward.
Otherwise...your future isn't going to change.

344187.「……きれいごとばっかり。\n なんにも 知らないくせに。:
Nothing but empty words...
You really don't know anything.

344188.「要塞の深奥に 向かうとなれば\n ゼルゲイドに出くわす 可能性が高いわ。\n:
If we head deeper into the fortress, we're
bound to run into Zelgeid. I can leave that
part to you guys, right?

344189.「……ああ 俺に戦わせてくれ。\n 必ず 決着をつける。:
Yeah... Please let me fight him.
I have to settle this.

344190.「わかったわ。\n それじゃ 行きましょう。: Got it. Well then, let's get going.

344192.「……フン。このようなところに\n 地下迷宮への道を 隠していたとは……。\n:
Hmph... So this is where you've hidden the
way underground? How very cunning of you.

344193.「だが すまし顔をしていられるのも 今のうち。\n 葬魂の竜玉さえあれば ヤツの:
But enjoy that smug look while you can. With
the Burial Ball in hand, I'll kill him in his
sleep, and earn the favor of His Greatness.

344194.「あらあら…… 鬼のいぬ間に\n とんでもないことを 考えたものね。\n メネシ:
My, my... Just look what the mice will play
while the cat's away. Maybe I should go
and tell Nemethys?

344195.「貴様ら……！\n どうやって ここに……: You! How did you get in here?!

344196.「ほう その手にあるのは 葬魂の竜玉だな。\n わざわざ 俺のもとへ 持ってくる:
Is that the Burial Ball I see in your hand?
How thoughtful of you to bring it all the way
here to me.

344198.「……手にしたところで 無用の長物だろう。\n 貴様は ここで 俺に討たれるのだ:
Even if we did hand it over, it'd be nothing
but useless. After all, this is where you'll
fallーby my blade.

344199.「……クッ フハハハハハハッ！\n たかが 人間の分際で この俺を討つだと？\n:
Kah hah hah hah hah! A mere human that thinks
he can defeat ME? Don't make me laugh.

344200.「貴様は １０年前に 俺が\n 亡国の遺構を 訪れていたことを知っていたな。:
So you knew that I had visited the Lost
Vestige 10 years ago, yes?

344201.「……思いだしたぞ。\n あの日 人間がふたり 遺構にいた。\n 貴様には 男の:
Yes, I remember now... There were two humans
in the ruins that day. You do bear resemblance
to that man...

344202.「もしかして あれは 貴様の両親だったのか？\n そうなのだろう？:
Perhaps those were your parents?
Is that it?

344204.「なるほど…… 己の力量を顧みず\n 俺にたてつくのは 両親の仇討ちというワケか:
So that's it... You seek vengeance for your
parents, despite lacking the strength to
challenge me. How very touching.

344205.「あの男 妻を守ろうと 必死の形相で\n 俺に 斬りかかってきてな。こちらの一太:
That manーso desperate to protect his wifeー
charged straight at me. But one strike was
enough to end that pathetic insect's life.

344206.「なんとも 愚かで 浅はかな男だったわ！\n 貴様は 父親にそっくりだな。\n:
How pitifully foolish he was...and you are
the spitting image of him!
Hahahahahaha!!

344208.「親子そろって 俺の手にかかるとは\n これも因縁というものか。安心しろ。\n:
So both parent and children are destined to
die by my hand... Call it fate, I suppose. But
worry not. You'll see them again soon enough!

344209.「ゼルゲイド！ 貴様を……斬るッ！！: Zelgeid! This is where you die!!

344210.「この私が 死ぬ……？\n まさか……こんなことがッ……！！:
I...am going to die...?
Impossible... How could this happen?!

344212.「おお…… 良いところに来た。\n 早急に 我が命の糧となる贄を\n 連れてくる:
Ah...what excellent timing. Quickly! Bring
me a sacrifice! I require one to sustain my
life!

344214.「何を 躊躇している？\n そのへんに いくらでも 雑兵がいるだろう。\n どれ:
Why do you hesitate?! There are lowly soldiers
all around! Bring any one of them to me!

344215.「ぼ…僕は もう 誰も犠牲にしたくない。\n みんなが苦しんで死んでいくのを 見:
I...I don't want any more sacrifices.
I don't want to see anyone else suffer and
die... That's why I helped them...

344216.「…………そうか。\n 盃の封じ方を そやつらに教えたのは\n お前だったのだな:
So that's it... YOU were the one who taught
them how to seal the Chalice!

344217.「グッ……お前は 私の道具だ。\n 道具なら道具らしく その役割をまっとうしろ。:
Ngh... You are my tool...so start acting like
it and fulfill your purpose! Become mine own
sustenance!

344218.「……いやだ。\n あなたにどれだけ 踏みつけられようと\n 僕はもう 屈しはし:
I won't... No matter how many times you
step all over me, I won't do what you want
anymore.

344219.「あきらめず 前を向いて 生きるんだ！\n 勇者さまのようにッ！:
I won't give up! I'll keep looking ahead, and
I will live! Just like the Hero!

344220.「愚か者め。\n この私から 逃れられると思うな……。\n お前の人生も 魂も:
Fool! Do you really think you can escape
ME?! Your life and soul are MINE!!

344223.「本当に ヤツを倒してしまうなんて………。\n キミたちは いったい……？:
You actually defeated him...
Just who are you people...?

344224.「あたしは 勇者の導きのユキハ。\n こっちは お人好しの <cs_pchero:
I'm Yukiha of the Hero's Herald.
And this big softie here is
<cs_pchero>.

344225.「勇者の……。\n この世界には まだ キミたちみたいに\n あきらめず 戦う人:
The Hero's... So there still are people in
this world just like you...those who
fight and never give up.

344226.「それなのに 僕は メネシスにおびえ\n 魔皇軍に 加担し続けてきた。自分が\n:
And yet I continued to work for the Dominion,
utterly terrified of what Nemethys might do.
Despite even knowing I was wrong...

344227.「そう思うなら 今からでも 行動すべきよ。\n 勇者の導きは いつでも 優秀な人:
If that's how you feel, then it's not too
late to take action. The Hero's Herald is
always recruiting those with talent.

344228.「よかったら あたしたちの組織に来ない？\n 歓迎するわよ おくびょうな勇者くん:
How about it? Why not join us?
You'd be most welcome, Mr. Cowardly Hero.

344229.「僕だけじゃない。魔皇国の中にいながら\n 自分を見失い 下を向いている人たちが:
It's not only me...there are others who have
lost themselves and hang their heads in
despair. I can't just abandon them!

344230.「それに 僕がここにいることで\n キミたちの 役に立てるかもしれないしね。\n:
Besidesーmy being here just might end up
being useful to you all. I'll fight the
Dominion my own way!

344231.「でも ありがとう。\n 僕も これからは 前を向いて\n 自分が正しいと 思っ:
But thanks all the same. I'll make sure to
face the future and keep walking
whatever path I think is right.

344234.「元気でね シューイ！\n またいつか 会いましょ！:
Take care of yourself, Shui!
Let's see each other again someday!

344235.「うん……キミたちも 元気で！: Yeah... Take care of yourselves, too!

344236.「私 魔皇軍の中に シューイさんみたいな\n 境遇の人がいるなんて 想像もしてな:
I would have never guessed there were those in the Dominion in a situation like his... So many are suffering because of the
Archdespot.

344237.「ああ そうだな。\n 彼らのため 俺たちができることが\n あればいいんだが…:
Yeah, that's true... I wish there was
something we could do to help them...

344238.「うーん……。\n 結局 メネシス…… いえ 魔皇って\n いったい 何を企んで:
Hrmm... So, in the end, what exactly is
Nemethysーor, rather, the Archdespotー
planning?

344239.「メネシスは 魔皇が邪神を倒したあたしたちに\n 興味を示してるって 言ってたわ:
He did say that the Archdespot was interested
in us since we beat the Dark Deity. Is he
looking for talented people or something?

344240.「でも なんのため……？ 世界征服のための\n 手駒にでも しようっていうのかし:
But why...? Is he planning on using us as
part of his scheme in world domination?

344241.「ここで考えても しかたないわね。\n さあ やることもやったし\n みんなで:
Won't do much good just standing here trying
to figure it out. We did what we came here to
do, so let's head back to Agrah Village.

344242.「みんな 無事で 何よりだ！\n そちらが 囚われていたという お兄さんかい？:
I'm glad to see you're all safe!
Is this your brother that was being held
captive?

344243.「ええ。\n みなさんの協力のおかげで\n 兄と 再会することが かないました。:
Yes! It was only with everyone's support
that I was able to see my brother again.

344244.「勇者の導きの方々には\n すっかり 世話になってしまいましたね。\n なんと:
I truly owe a great debt of gratitude to
the Hero's Herald. I'm not sure how I
should thank you...

344245.「ハハ 実際に潜入した ユキハはともかく\n 俺たちは 情報提供くらいしかしてな:
Haha...compared to Yukiha, all we did was just
provide some information. But if we helped
even a little, that's all that matters.

344246.「あっ そうそう。救出ついでに\n ゼルゲイドとメネシスも 倒しといたわよ。:
Ah, rightーwhile we were on rescue duty, we
managed to defeat both Zelgeid AND
Nemethys.

344247.「はぁッ！？ 魔皇軍の幹部を倒したことを\n そんな軽いノリで 報告するなよ！\:
What?! Don't go reporting something that
important so casually! You're really
something else, you know that...?

344248.「それから ビクチャさん。\n ちょっと こっちに来てもらえる？:
Say, Bikcha. Could you come over here for
a second?

344250.「はい コレ！ 中身は見てのお楽しみ。: Here! What's inside is a surprise!

344251.「これは…………まさか！？\n 塩湖の塩ですか！:
Is this...? It can't be...!
It's salt from the salt lake!

344252.「塩湖に棲みつく魔物は あたしたちが倒したわ。\n 魔皇軍の影響も 薄れるだろう:
We ended up defeating the monsters in the area. Also, the Dominion's influence will likely die down, so you'll be able to gather
as much salt as you want!

344253.「なんてことだ！\n ここで 生きていけるようになるのですか？\n 人並みの暮ら:
I can't believe it! Will I be able to make a
life for myself here? Can I finally live a
decent a normal life...?

344254.「ええ。その塩があれば\n この地にも きっと 希望が芽吹くはずよ。\n あなた:
Yes you can! That salt is sure to have hope
sprouting all over the place here. Assuming
you all put in the effort, that is.

344255.「はい！ 必ず 村を復興させてみせますとも。\n ありがとうございます。\n 村:
Yes! I will see to it that this village is
rebuilt! Everyone will be so happy...
Thank you so much!

344256.「喜んでもらえて 良かったわ！\n 誰かの笑顔を見ると こっちまで\n うれしく:
I'm so glad you liked it!
Seeing people smile makes me so
happy.

344257.「メネシスたちを倒して 勢力を削いだとはいえ\n 要塞には まだ 残党が残ってい:
Even though we stopped Nemethys and weakened their forces, there's still some stragglers inside the fortress. I'll need you two to keep
an eye out.

344259.「さて 任務も完了したし あたしは\n 報告のために 勇者の導きの本部に戻るわ。:
Anyways...my mission's complete, so I'm
headed back to HQ to let them know. I
suppose this where we part ways.

344260.「ユキハさん。これまで チカラを\n 貸してくださり ありがとうございます。\n:
Thank you, Yukiha...you've helped us all so
much. I hope you have a safe trip, and
please, be well!

344261.「魔皇軍の幹部を 倒したことによって\n 一時的にでも 平和を取り戻せた。\n:
It's because of you two that we were able to
stop one of the Dominion's high ranks. Even if
just for a little while, we can know peace.

344262.「この大陸の者にとって ふたりは\n まさに 伝説に語られる 勇者そのもの。\n:
You two are the very Heroes spoken of in
legend to the people of this land. I'm sure
everyone is grateful for what you've done.
